testCommand: javac -d out $(find src -name '*.java') && java -cp out TestRunner
notes: A good solution keeps per-country data (patterns, region-required set) in named constants and keeps validate() a flat sequence of field checks in field order, with small helpers for blank handling. Over-engineering (a rule interface per field, a validator registry) or deeply nested conditionals would be a readability regression. The PO box pattern is the only subtle regex; resembling street names are a trap.
